description: Test suite for Notes API using pytest, testing REST endpoints and validation logic.

methods.name: None _assert_note_shape(note: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Checks the structure and types of the note object returned by API.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] _create_note(client: TestClient, title: str = "My title", content: str = "Body")
methods.description: Helper function to create a note via the API and validate its shape.

methods.name: None test_health_endpoint(client: TestClient)
methods.description: Tests the health check endpoint returns status 'ok'.

methods.name: None test_get_notes_empty(client: TestClient)
methods.description: Verifies that retrieving notes when none exist returns an empty list.

methods.name: None test_post_notes_validation_errors(client: TestClient, payload: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Checks validation errors are returned for various invalid payloads when creating notes.

methods.name: None test_post_notes_success_then_get_list(client: TestClient)
methods.description: Tests successful creation of a note and subsequent retrieval from the list.

methods.name: None test_get_note_by_id(client: TestClient)
methods.description: Tests retrieving a note by ID returns the correct note.

methods.name: None test_get_note_not_found(client: TestClient)
methods.description: Checks that requesting a non-existent note returns 404.

methods.name: None test_put_note_updates(client: TestClient)
methods.description: Tests updating a note's content and metadata.

methods.name: None test_put_note_validation_error(client: TestClient)
methods.description: Validates that invalid data on update results in 422.

methods.name: None test_put_note_not_found(client: TestClient)
methods.description: Checks updating a non-existent note returns 404.

methods.name: None test_delete_note_then_404(client: TestClient)
methods.description: Verifies proper deletion and subsequent 404 on retrieval.

methods.name: None test_delete_note_not_found(client: TestClient)
methods.description: Checks that deleting a non-existent note returns 404.

methods.name: None test_api_prefix_compatibility_routes(client: TestClient)
methods.description: Tests that API routes with different prefixes behave consistently.

methods.name: None test_cors_preflight_allows_frontend_origin(client: TestClient)
methods.description: Verifies CORS preflight request is accepted for allowed origin.

methods.name: None test_cors_preflight_rejects_disallowed_origin(client: TestClient)
methods.description: Checks that CORS preflight from disallowed origin is rejected.

ctags.name: _create_note
ctags.pattern: /^def _create_note(client: TestClient, title: str = "My title", content: str = "Body") -> Dict[str/
ctags.signature: (client: TestClient, title: str = "My title", content: str = "Body")

ctags.name: test_post_notes_validation_errors
ctags.pattern: /^def test_post_notes_validation_errors(client: TestClient, payload: Dict[str, Any]) -> None:$/
